title: A normalized source for a right-derived direct image
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories with the same object and morphism universes and chosen unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] in a common localization universe. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and let $(R,\eta)$ be a specified total right derived functor of $F$, with its universal unit, its invertible computation on K-injective complexes, and its exact shift structure. Let $M\in\mathcal A$, $N\in\mathcal B$, $P$ a proposition, and $\mathrm{normalizes}$ a predicate on pairs $(e,h)$ with $e:N\simeq F(M)$ and $h:P$. Using the canonical single-object comparison $s_{F,R,M}:F(M)[0]\to R(M[0])$ of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], define a normalized source to consist of $h:P$, an isomorphism $e:N\simeq F(M)$, a proof of $\mathrm{normalizes}(e,h)$, and the assertion that $s_{F,R,M}$ is invertible. Its associated morphism $N[0]\to R(M[0])$ is exactly $e[0]$ followed by $s_{F,R,M}$. This records a specified ordinary normalization and acyclicity; it asserts no existence of such data.
